bugs.title: No debounce: every bounce edge toggles the armed lamp
bugs.description: The loop reads D6 and calls toggleArmed() on every HIGH-to-LOW transition (lines 52-57) with no settle window, so each contact bounce edge is counted as a separate press. Measured evidence shows 4 toggles per press in the bounce scenario ([4, 4, 4, 4]) and 3 per press in the rapid and stress scenarios, far exceeding the required exactly one toggle per press. The spec's 50 ms settle window is never implemented, and the spurious toggles at 1.40 s with no press confirm bounce edges are being accepted as presses. 4 of 4 press(es) did not toggle D9 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [4, 4, 4, 4]. D9 also toggled 12 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 1.40 s.
